\newcommand{\HLabelDefinition}{Bounds: within 25\% of the median lowering duration of the set's first 3 counted reps. v\_t = 1 when the lowering duration of counted rep t is outside the bounds. The event is the set's first sustained departure: the first rep k with v\_k = 1 and at least 2 of reps k..k+2 outside. Y\_t = 1 when that departure starts at one of reps t+1..t+2. Origins need 3 counted reps, v\_t = 0 and no departure yet; an origin whose deciding reps include an uncounted attempt, or run past the end of the set, or that lies after the departure, is excluded.}
